name: retries use the inclusive N plus one attempt boundary
input: a job that succeeds on its final allowed attempt

name: dependency release respects priority and actual concurrency limit
test:
import threading, time
started = []; active = [0]; peak = [0]; gate = threading.Event(); lock = threading.Lock()
def run(job, attempt):
    with lock:
        started.append(job.job_id); active[0] += 1; peak[0] = max(peak[0], active[0])
    if job.job_id in {'high', 'low'}: gate.wait(0.2)
    with lock: active[0] -= 1
    return True
scheduler = Scheduler([Job('low', priority=1), Job('high', priority=3), Job('after', dependencies=('high',))], ConcurrencyLimiter(1), run)
thread = threading.Thread(target=scheduler.run); thread.start(); time.sleep(0.04); assert started == ['high']; gate.set(); thread.join(1)
assert peak[0] == 1
assert started.index('after') > started.index('high')
